query:
WITH current_reports AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (file_id) id
            FROM delphi_reports
            WHERE file_id IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY file_id, delphi_version DESC
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT didws.project_id AS "project_id!: DBProjectId"
        FROM current_reports cr
        INNER JOIN delphi_report_issues dri ON dri.report_id = cr.id
        INNER JOIN delphi_issue_details_with_statuses didws
            ON didws.issue_id = dri.id
        WHERE didws.key = ANY($1::text[])
